# Spanish A1→B1 in 6 Months

A steady **5 hours/week** can get you from beginner to solid intermediate if you keep the routine consistent and recycle vocabulary every week. This plan uses only free resources and balances listening, speaking, reading, and writing.

## 24-Week Spanish Learning Roadmap

| Week | Focus | Listening | Speaking | Reading | Writing | Goal Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sounds, greetings, alphabet | 10 min/day pronunciation + greetings audio | Introduce yourself in 5 lines | Read basic greetings + numbers | Write name, country, age, likes | Say a 30-second self-intro |
| 2 | Numbers, time, days, family | Short beginner dialogues | Ask/tell time, family basics | Simple family descriptions | Write 6–8 sentences about family | Understand a 1-minute slow dialogue |
| 3 | Ser vs. estar, adjectives | Beginner videos on descriptions | Describe people and places | Read short profiles | Write a short personal profile | Use ser/estar correctly in 8 sentences |
| 4 | Present tense regular verbs | Daily mini-dialogues | Talk about routines | Read routine texts | Write your daily routine | Give a 1-minute routine monologue |
| 5 | Articles, gender, plural | Listen for noun endings | Use articles in simple speech | Read short object descriptions | Write shopping or classroom items | Score 80% on articles/plural quiz |
| 6 | Common verbs and survival phrases | Travel/basic survival audio | Order, ask directions, request help | Read signs, menus, short notices | Write 8 useful phrases | Handle a simple role-play |
| 7 | Review 1–6 | Mixed beginner audio | 2-minute self-intro + routine | Re-read old texts faster | Write a 10-sentence summary | Retell 3 topics without notes |
| 8 | **Checkpoint 1** | Understand slow beginner audio | Speak for 2 minutes | Read a short graded text | Write 80–100 words | Mini-test: 70%+ on all four skills |
| 9 | Present tense expansion | Short podcasts for learners | Talk about hobbies and preferences | Read hobby/interests text | Write about free time | Use 20 core verbs in context |
| 10 | Question forms, negatives | Listen for question words | Ask/answer 10 questions | Read Q&A dialogues | Write 10 questions about yourself | Hold a 2-minute Q&A |
| 11 | Reflexive verbs, daily life | Beginner audio on routines | Describe morning/evening habits | Read daily life paragraphs | Write your weekday routine | Use reflexive verbs naturally |
| 12 | Weather, clothing, shopping | Listen to weather forecasts | Talk about weather and clothes | Read weather/shopping texts | Write a packing list + reasons | Describe a forecast in 5 sentences |
| 13 | Past intro: preterite basics | Listen for completed actions | Tell what you did yesterday | Read short past events | Write 6–8 sentences in past tense | Narrate one past day clearly |
| 14 | Past tense practice | Short stories in simple Spanish | Tell a weekend story | Read a simple story | Write a short diary entry | Use past verbs with fewer errors |
| 15 | Comparisons and opinions | Listen for opinion words | Compare two things | Read product/travel comparisons | Write pros and cons | Give 3 comparisons aloud |
| 16 | **Checkpoint 2** | Understand 2–3 minute learner audio | Speak for 3 minutes | Read a short article | Write 100–120 words | Mini-test: 75%+ and one spoken recording |
| 17 | Future with ir a + infinitive | Listen to plans and intentions | Talk about next week/month | Read plans and schedules | Write future plans | Make 10 future sentences |
| 18 | Directions, transport, travel | Listen to route/direction audio | Ask for directions | Read maps/signs | Write a travel plan | Give directions from memory |
| 19 | Food, restaurants, preferences | Listen to ordering dialogues | Order food, explain preferences | Read menus and reviews | Write a restaurant review | Role-play a restaurant conversation |
| 20 | Pronouns and object basics | Listen for pronouns in context | Replace repeated nouns in speech | Read short dialogues | Rewrite 6 sentences with pronouns | Use pronouns without confusion |
| 21 | Longer reading, main ideas | Listen to slightly longer stories | Summarize a short audio | Read a short article and identify main idea | Write a summary | Summarize in 5–6 sentences |
| 22 | Conversation fluency | Mixed native/learner audio | 4-minute conversation practice | Read for gist, not every word | Write an opinion paragraph | Speak with fewer pauses |
| 23 | B1 consolidation | Audio on familiar topics | Talk about experiences, plans, opinions | Read a short news-style text | Write 120–150 words | Pass a full review set |
| 24 | **Checkpoint 3** | Understand familiar spoken Spanish | 5-minute self-presentation | Read a short article with support | Write a structured paragraph | Compare against Week 1 and note gains |

## Weekly Study Rhythm

### Weekday Sessions
- **Monday: Listening + shadowing**
  - 20 min listening
  - 15 min repeat aloud
  - 10 min review vocabulary

- **Tuesday: Grammar + writing**
  - 20 min grammar lesson
  - 20 min sentence practice
  - 5 min review

- **Wednesday: Reading + vocabulary**
  - 25 min graded reading or short text
  - 15 min new words
  - 5 min recap

- **Thursday: Speaking**
  - 15 min guided speaking prompts
  - 15 min self-recording
  - 15 min correction and retry

- **Friday: Mixed review**
  - 15 min review all week’s material
  - 15 min listening or reading
  - 15 min writing recap

### Weekend Session
- **Saturday or Sunday: 1-hour integration**
  - 15 min listening
  - 15 min speaking
  - 15 min reading
  - 15 min writing
  - End with a short self-test

## Free Resource Set

- **Grammar and exercises:** SpanishDict, StudySpanish, Conjuguemos
- **Listening:** Dreaming Spanish, Coffee Break Spanish free lessons, Notes in Spanish free content
- **Reading:** News in Slow Spanish free samples, graded reader samples, LingQ free articles
- **Speaking practice:** self-recording, language exchange apps with free tiers, shadowing from videos
- **Writing practice:** journal entries, corrected sentence rewrites, short summaries

## Progress Check System

### Weekly Scorecard
Rate each skill from **0–2**:
- **Listening:** 0 = not understood, 1 = partial, 2 = mostly clear
- **Speaking:** 0 = hard to produce, 1 = short/simple, 2 = fluid for the week’s topic
- **Reading:** 0 = need translation, 1 = gist only, 2 = main idea + details
- **Writing:** 0 = many errors, 1 = understandable, 2 = clear and mostly correct

**Weekly target:** 6–7 points out of 8

### Monthly Checkpoints
- **End of Month 1:** introduce yourself, describe routine, understand slow beginner speech
- **End of Month 2:** handle present tense and simple daily conversations
- **End of Month 3:** tell simple past events and write short paragraphs
- **End of Month 4:** understand familiar topics and speak for 3–4 minutes
- **End of Month 5:** discuss plans, opinions, travel, food
- **End of Month 6:** reach strong A2 / early B1 performance on familiar everyday topics

### Simple Success Rule
- If you miss a week, do not skip ahead.
- Repeat the same week once, then continue.
- Keep one running notebook with:
  - 20 new words/week
  - 5 useful phrases/week
  - 1 speaking recording/week
  - 1 short writing sample/week

## Quick Actions

- Action: [Button: Free Grammar] https://www.spanishdict.com/guide
- Action: [Button: Listening Practice] https://www.dreamingspanish.com/
- Action: [Button: Verb Practice] https://conjuguemos.com/

## Sources

- SpanishDict grammar guide: https://www.spanishdict.com/guide
- Dreaming Spanish: https://www.dreamingspanish.com/
- Conjuguemos practice: https://conjuguemos.com/
- StudySpanish: https://studyspanish.com/
